profile.name: Satyam Rajpoot
profile.tagline: Crafting next-generation 3D interactive web experiences and robust full-stack applications with obsessive attention to design and performance.
profile.bio: Hello! I am Satyam Rajpoot, a passionate Web Developer with 3+ years of experience turning complex ideas into sleek, fluid digital realities. I specialize in modern JavaScript, React, Three.js, and high-performance Node.js backends. When I'm not pushing code, I'm exploring bleeding-edge web animations and user-centric architecture.
